==Description==
The '''Sin''' is an enemy that only appears when summoned on death by a [[Demon]]. It has a rather low amount of health for its debut, though it spawns in large hordes from the [[Demon]]. It also has the [[Burn Immunity]], meaning it cannot be set on fire.

==Appearance==
The '''Sin''' has a black and red magma body, with a head that had an open mouth with jagged teeth and a pair of horns. The interior of the head is glowing yellow. It also has a small tail.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers, like the [[Pursuit]], [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] or [[Turret]] are recommended against this.
**As it always spawns in groups from [[Demon]]s, high DPS towers with splash damage capabilities, like the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Engineer]] can be especially useful here.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of these towers.
*Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be helpful at clearing out the '''Sins'''.
